verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing names 'Billing automations' that control customer communications, offers built-in automatic actions such as Smart Retries for failed payments, and pushes real-time webhook events. However, user-defined event-triggered rules appear mostly to require writing your own webhook handler code. missing for 10: documentation of a configurable rule builder (triggers, conditions, actions), detail on what Billing automations can do beyond communications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
